comments.en:
Normative basis: ISO/IEC 7498-1:1994.

Twenty-six classes and four relations. Every definition carries a German wording alongside its English translation.

The layers, the technologies and the kinds of data unit are modelled as subclasses.

Scope: the layered structure of a communication and what travels over it. The open system with its subsystems and entities, services and protocols, the transmission modes and the quality of service are not covered.

abstract.value: An ontology design pattern for describing the communication between the components of an automated plant, following the layered architecture of ISO/IEC 7498-1, the Basic Reference Model of Open Systems Interconnection. A communication is structured into the seven layers of the reference model, each layer is realised by a technology such as Ethernet, IP or MQTT, and the content carried is a data unit assigned either to a layer or to the communication itself. The layers, the technologies and the kinds of data unit are modelled as subclasses. The pattern is one of three subdomain patterns of the AIAS information model and is meant to be imported and aligned rather than used on its own.

comment.de: Publish-Subscribe-Protokoll der Anwendungsschicht.
comment.en: A publish and subscribe protocol of the application layer.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 5.6.

comment.de: Abgegrenzte, zusammenhängende Datenmenge, die von einer Schicht des OSI-Modells als Einheit verarbeitet oder übertragen wird.
comment.en: A delimited, coherent quantity of data processed or transmitted by a layer of the OSI model as one unit.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 7.5.

comment.de: Organisiert die paketweise Weiterleitung von Daten über mehrere Netze hinweg.
comment.en: Organises the forwarding of data packet by packet across several networks.

note.value: The one practice term ISO/IEC 7498-1 names: 7.7.3.3.1 refers to the transparent transmission of bit streams.

comment.de: Dateneinheit der Bitübertragungsschicht.
comment.en: The data unit of the physical layer.

comment.de: Internet Protocol, eine Technologie der Vermittlungsschicht.
comment.en: The Internet Protocol, a technology of the network layer.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 7.3.

comment.de: Verwaltet Sitzungen zwischen Anwendungen, deren Aufbau, Steuerung und Synchronisation.
comment.en: Manages sessions between applications, their establishment, control and synchronisation.

comment.de: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol, eine Technologie der Anwendungsschicht.
comment.en: The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol, a technology of the application layer.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, 5.2.1.2. Clause 6.1.2 enumerates exactly seven layers.

comment.de: Abgegrenzte Funktionsgruppe, die auf einem bestimmten Abstraktionsniveau definierte Kommunikationsaufgaben erfüllt.
comment.en: A delimited group of functions carrying out defined communication tasks at a given level of abstraction.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 7.2.

comment.de: Wandelt Daten in ein gemeinsames Format und übernimmt Codierung, Kompression und gegebenenfalls Verschlüsselung.
comment.en: Converts data into a common format and carries out coding, compression and where required encryption.

comment.de: File Transfer Protocol, eine Technologie der Anwendungsschicht.
comment.en: The File Transfer Protocol, a technology of the application layer.

note.value: Not a term of ISO/IEC 7498-1. A note to 7.6.4.5 observes that the delimiting function of the data link layer is sometimes referred to as framing, but the standard defines no such data unit.

comment.de: Dateneinheit der Sicherungsschicht.
comment.en: The data unit of the data link layer.

note.value: A class name beginning with a digit is awkward in a namespace, so the class is called Ethernet1000BASET and carries the practice name 1000BASE-T as its label.

comment.de: Gigabit-Ethernet über Twisted-Pair-Verkabelung, eine Technologie der Bitübertragungsschicht.
comment.en: Gigabit Ethernet over twisted pair cabling, a technology of the physical layer.

comment.de: Technologiefamilie der Sicherungsschicht.
comment.en: A family of technologies of the data link layer.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 7.4.

comment.de: Stellt Ende-zu-Ende-Verbindungen zwischen Kommunikationspartnern bereit und segmentiert Datenströme.
comment.en: Provides end-to-end connections between communicating partners and segments data streams.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 7.6.

comment.de: Bildet aus Bits Datenrahmen und regelt den Zugriff auf das Übertragungsmedium.
comment.en: Forms frames out of bits and governs access to the transmission medium.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 7.1.

comment.de: Stellt direkt der Anwendung Dienste wie Dateiübertragung oder Remote-Zugriff zur Verfügung und nutzt dafür die Dienste der unteren Schichten.
comment.en: Provides services such as file transfer or remote access directly to the application, using the services of the layers below.

note.value: Not a class of ISO/IEC 7498-1. Clause 1.3 states that the fact a system is open implies no particular implementation or technology, so the standard names none.

comment.de: Konkretes Protokoll oder Übertragungsverfahren, das die Aufgaben einer Schicht realisiert.
comment.en: A concrete protocol or transmission technique realising the tasks of a layer.

comment.de: Hypertext Transfer Protocol, eine Technologie der Anwendungsschicht.
comment.en: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol, a technology of the application layer.

comment.de: Transmission Control Protocol, eine Technologie der Transportschicht.
comment.en: The Transmission Control Protocol, a technology of the transport layer.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, definition 4.2.10. The standard itself calls this an association. Communication is the plainer term, and is the one used here.

comment.de: Verbindung zwischen mindestens zwei Systemkomponenten, die den gerichteten Austausch von Daten beschreibt.
comment.en: A connection between at least two system components describing the directed exchange of data.

comment.de: HTTP über eine gesicherte Verbindung, eine Technologie der Anwendungsschicht.
comment.en: HTTP over a secured connection, a technology of the application layer.

note.value: Not a term of ISO/IEC 7498-1 for a data unit. It stands for what an application exchanges, without separating the payload of a single transmission from a dataset as a whole.

comment.de: Dateneinheit der oberen Schichten, also das, was eine Anwendung austauscht.
comment.en: The data unit of the upper layers, that is what an application exchanges.

note.value: Not a term of ISO/IEC 7498-1 in this sense. The standard uses segmenting as the name of a function, 5.8.1.9, that maps one service data unit onto several protocol data units.

comment.de: Dateneinheit der Transportschicht.
comment.en: The data unit of the transport layer.

note.value: Not a term of ISO/IEC 7498-1, but of the network layer protocol standards.

comment.de: Dateneinheit der Vermittlungsschicht.
comment.en: The data unit of the network layer.

note.value: ISO/IEC 7498-1, clause 7.7.

comment.de: Überträgt rohe Bits als elektrische, optische oder Funksignale über ein physisches Medium.
comment.en: Transmits raw bits as electrical, optical or radio signals over a physical medium.

note.value: Not a class of ISO/IEC 7498-1. A construct of this model, so that a communication can be referred to by a name of its own.

comment.de: Bezeichnung, unter der eine Kommunikation bekannt ist.
comment.en: The designation under which a communication is known.

note.value:
One relation with two domains: the content transmitted is assigned to the respective layer, or to the communication directly.

hasDU is kept as an alternative label, since that is the short form the relation is commonly written as.

comment.de: Verbindet eine Schicht oder die Kommunikation selbst mit der Dateneinheit, die sie verarbeitet oder überträgt.
comment.en: Relates a layer, or a communication itself, to the data unit it processes or transmits.

comment.de: Verbindet eine Kommunikation mit einer Schicht, in die sie gegliedert ist.
comment.en: Relates a communication to a layer it is structured into.

note.value: Whether a given technology fits the layer it is claimed for is not checked here. Nothing stops a model from placing MQTT at the network layer.

comment.de: Verbindet eine Schicht mit der Technologie, die sie realisiert.
comment.en: Relates a layer to the technology realising it.

comment.de: Verbindet eine Kommunikation mit ihrer Bezeichnung.
comment.en: Relates a communication to its designation.
